# gigahost_dns_zone_dnssec (Resource)

Enables DNSSEC for a domain registered with Gigahost. For zones on Gigahost nameservers the zone is signed and the DS records are submitted to the registry automatically. For externally hosted domains only the DNSSEC flag is set; submit the DS records with `gigahost_dns_zone_ds_records`. Destroying the resource disables DNSSEC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gigahost_dns_zone_dnssec" "example" {
  zone_id = gigahost_dns_zone.example.zone_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_id` (String) Id of the DNS zone (registered domain).

### Read-Only

- `ds_records` (String) DS records as reported by the Gigahost API (text, or configuration instructions for externally hosted domains).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# DNSSEC can be imported by the zone id.
terraform import gigahost_dns_zone_dnssec.example 123
```
